01 / The challenge

The challenge for marine & boatyards.

Boatyards, marine engineers and Broads hire firms work by the water, where salt, damp and UV are hard on vehicles. We specify films and aftercare for waterside use, and can brand trailers and service vans to match.

01

Salt and damp

Waterside vehicles face salt air and damp conditions.

02

Trailers and tenders

Boat trailers and service vehicles need consistent branding.

03

Seasonal trade

Broads and coastal businesses have a busy summer.

02 / What to include

What your van must say.

  • Business name
  • Service: boatyard, marine engineering, hire
  • Phone number and website
  • Location, e.g. river or harbour

Not sure what to include? Our guide to what to put on a work van walks you through it.

05 / Price guide

Budget for the coverage you need.

Price guide for marine & boatyards
PackagePrice guideTypical scope
SignwritingPublished signwriting packages from £149Logos, a service line and contact details.
Partial wrapQuoted per vehiclePrinted panels or colour across selected areas.
Full wrapQuoted per vehiclePrinted imagery or brand colours across most exterior panels.
Fleet graphicsQuoted per fleetA shared layout adapted for each make and model.

The signwriting benchmark comes from Broadland Digital’s published packages. Ask for a fitted quote covering your vehicle size, artwork, film, coverage and VAT.

06 / Design tips

Build the layout around the job.

01

Choose laminated film

A laminate protects the print from salt and UV.

02

Rinse after salty trips

Regular fresh-water rinsing helps graphics last longer.

03

Match the trailers

A branded trailer at a slipway is great advertising.

Before you book

Good to know.

Will the wrap cope with salt air?

Yes, with laminated cast film and regular rinsing. We will give you aftercare advice.

Can you brand boat trailers?

Yes. Send photos and measurements of the trailer.

Do you brand boats?

We focus on vehicles and trailers. Ask us if you have a specific vessel project in mind.
